source.quote: NEO's Original Strategy Reveal: August 2024 — when the company unveiled its strategy to develop NEO

timeline.detail: Preorders open with a $200 deposit; company states first units ship to US consumer homes in 2026, other markets from 2027.

source.quote: first orders shipping to consumer homes in 2026

promises.claim: First Neo orders shipping to US consumer homes
promises.quote: NEO is now available for pre-order, with first orders shipping to consumer homes in 2026.

promises.claim: Neo delivery expansion beyond the US
promises.quote: 1X said it will start delivering NEOs primarily in the U.S and expand to other markets starting in 2027.

order_type.note: 1x.tech/order takes a fully refundable $200 deposit against either a $20,000 Ownership plan or a $499/mo subscription, with US deliveries starting in 2026 -- a deposit-and-wait-for-delivery flow, not an immediate cart checkout.

source.quote: much of the work will be done by teleoperators in the beginning

review.reason: The text source was reviewed, but no video segment was watched; the existing capability status and autonomy classification for Neo were not fully verified.

capabilities.note: 1X CEO Bernt Børnich, quoted 2025-10-29, confirms Neo home demos and early customer units rely on remote human operators (1X calls them 'Experts') viewing the home via the robot's cameras, not autonomous operation.

notes: As of 2026-09-20, 1X has not published evidence of any consumer unit delivered — only preorder/deposit terms and a 2026 shipping promise. Per this dataset's rules, that keeps delivery.status at claimed, not shipped, regardless of marketing language like "order today".

Height was not found stated on 1X's own current page during this build; third-party coverage estimates "5-foot-6" but that is not a manufacturer source, so height_cm is omitted here rather than sourced to a secondary outlet.

charge_time_min, battery_swappable, actuator_torque_nm, and sdk were left out (2026-09-21): 1x.tech/order states only a charge rate ("6min per hour runtime", not a single full-charge minutes figure) and does not state swappability, joint torque, or any developer SDK/API.
